1.explanation: In crossref.ts the function crossrefFilterActive(options) only checks metadata.crossref at the top level, ignoring format-specific keys (e.g. metadata.format.html.crossref). As a result, the crossref Lua filter remains enabled even when the user has set format.html.crossref:false. runPandoc (in pandoc.ts) then unconditionally adds the crossref filter based on that incorrect predicate. Both files must be updated so that crossrefFilterActive reads the nested format.html.crossref setting and prevents injection of the crossref filter for HTML when disabled.
1.bug_scenario: The user’s QMD front matter sets format.html.crossref: false to disable cross-references in HTML. However, when rendering to HTML the figure still shows “Fig. 1 A placeholder image,” i.e. cross-reference numbering is not turned off. The screenshot demonstrates the unwanted “Fig. 1” prefix when crossref:false is specified under the html format.
